description: Derived from AGSC-01-16 and AGSC-01-34: an input file larger than its cap MUST be refused with AGSC-E904 (1 MiB, 1,048,576 bytes, for every input file outside content/attachments/; `attachments{max_bytes}`, default 1 MiB, for an attachment), an archive MUST be refused entirely with AGSC-E903, and any path escaping the Bundle root MUST be refused with AGSC-E902. Over the minimal fixture, whose lint reports nothing, the case adds: a concept attachment-holder whose three attachments are at-the-cap.txt (exactly 1,048,576 bytes: at the cap, not above it, so accepted; the large files are filled with full stops, which no lint reads as an encoded blob), over-the-cap.txt (1,048,577 bytes: AGSC-E904) and data.zip (an archive, the 22 bytes of an empty ZIP file, an end-of-central-directory record alone: AGSC-E903); a concept linked-attachments whose attachment folder content/attachments/linked-attachments is a symbolic link to `../../..`, the folder that holds the Bundle root, so that its attachment `hosts` lies outside the root (AGSC-E902); and content/concepts/oversize.md, an input file of 1,048,577 bytes (AGSC-E904), refused before it is read, so its content is never parsed. The whole list `lint` reports is these four errors, and lint exits 1. `add_sized_files` and `add_links` state the large files and the link, which a JSON string cannot carry.
